title: Don't Feed The Flames
author: William Saville
content:
Everywhere I turn,
I feel the ground shake,
Feel the ground burn.
America is facing turmoil and strife,
Loving objects not people,
Our World can't be balanced on the tip of a knife.
Better yet, on the barrel of a gun.
We are one race of humanity,
Not many races,
We are a sea of endless faces.
But we are more separated than ever.
Our world cannot survive like this,
On the blood, sweat and tears of some,
While the wealthy sit high up,
And collect their wages,
While we cannot get paid enough to live.
We must unite.
We are one race of humanity,
One race is all I see.
I see beauty in every shade.
Every color is beautiful and perfect to me.
Perfect in its complex simplicity.
We all have the same things inside of us,
Our hearts all beat,
Our eyes all shed water,
When we love it does not falter.
We cry out in different languages,
But our cries are the same.
Our world is burning,
And the ignorant are feeding the flames.
